blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust for Agri-Food Processing — zero-trust by architecture, not by slide — identity, detection, resilience and ai security in one program applied to the agri-food processing operating unit of Agriculture & Food Systems.

Food processors live on quality, yield and traceability: intake grading, process yield, food-safety evidence and provenance claims. Vision grading, yield analytics and chain-of-custody convert commodity margin into brand margin.

items: Plant networks flat; food-safety systems targeted.
Quality grading by inspectors; variance and throughput loss.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Cloud Security & Posture Management, AI Security & Model Protection, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Intake grading, Process yield analytics, Lot traceability) on Achala Sentinel and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Food safety (HACCP/EU 178/FSMA) among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Identity as the perimeter — workforce, customer and machine identities on one governed plane.
Secure at the control plane — posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
Secure the models themselves — prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
